newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Telephone to issue 625 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Thai Telephone to issue 625 mln shares.

text.p: Thai Telephone and Telecommunication Plc said on Thursday it would issue 625 million new shares to raise six billion baht ($240 million) to support new diversification projects.

The company said in a statement that 375 million shares would be offered to existing shareholders at the rate of two old shares per one new share. The par value would be 10 baht. Purchases could be made between March 3-7 next year.
Another 250 million shares will be placed privately at a price not less than 90 per cent of the stock's market price.
Thai Telephone and Telecommunication was contracted by the state-run Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT) to install 1.5 million telephone lines in Thailand's provinces.
The company completed installation in September but connection rates have not been as previously forecast.
The company's shares fell two baht to 25 at lunchbreak on Thursday.
